business_summary: DroneShield Limited is an Australia-listed (ASX: DRO) pure-play counter-UAS technology company selling RF detection, jamming and effector products. Its DroneSentry-X Mk2 is explicitly marketed as a ruggedized, IP67-rated system for topside maritime operation aboard patrol craft, cutters and auxiliary vessels.

exposure_summary.narrative: DroneShield's sole offshore-counter-drone placement is rf-detection-and-jamming, which the chain's own role text calls 'the layer with the cleanest listed pure play on this map'; the link is CROWDED (crowdedness 78) but scored a comparatively low impact (30), because the occurrence that anchors this chain was an explosive maritime surface drone rather than a communications-jammable target, a mismatch the chain states as its own finding. No revenue is disclosed broken out for offshore/maritime deployments specifically versus DroneShield's broader land-based and airport/border counter-UAS business.

disclosed_revenue_exposure.basis: no revenue percentage tied to maritime or offshore deployment specifically is sourced for DroneShield Limited this run. See data_gaps.

latest_fy.basis: Fiscal-year revenue for the period ended 2025-12-31: 216,547,000 AUD from the yfinance-statements statements in DRO-AX.json.

revenue_cagr_3y.basis: Compound annual revenue growth computed as (216,547,000/16,806,723)**(1/3.0007)-1 from the yfinance-statements revenue series, period ended 2022-12-31 to period ended 2025-12-31; a small 2022 revenue base makes this an unusually steep multi-year CAGR.

operating_margin.basis: Operating income -14,622,000 AUD divided by revenue 216,547,000 AUD, both for the period ended 2025-12-31, from the yfinance-statements series: an operating loss despite revenue growth.

operating_cash_flow_to_net_income.basis: operating_cashflow_fy is entirely absent from the yfinance-statements block in DRO-AX.json (coverage.missing includes operating_cashflow); operating cash flow to net income is not computable this run.

net_debt_to_ebitda.basis: Net debt -195,235,000 AUD (total debt 14,255,000 less cash 209,490,000, as of 2025-12-31; a large net cash position) divided by an EBITDA proxy of -4,043,000 AUD (operating loss -14,622,000 plus depreciation 10,579,000, period ended 2025-12-31). The positive ratio is an artifact of dividing two negative numbers (net cash by a negative EBITDA proxy), not a leverage read; the underlying facts are a large net cash balance against a small operating loss.
